chapter_title: Concerning the Eighteen Great Thrones of all the F

spiritual_reading.full_translation:
A full complement of comprehensive governing determinations is fixed in ordered degrees, set in definite stations. Though a portion of them is placed in the outer spiritual expanse, their rule still reaches through every state where devastation and disorder have spread, so that even ruined conditions remain under a measured appointment.

The first and highest determination is the inmost Divine itself in sovereign truth and good, self-subsistent and unconditioned, standing distinct from all derivations and giving every subordinate determination its order.

The second determination is glorified Divine wisdom, the origin from which the whole outflow of ordered spiritual forces proceeds down to the lowest region where renewal is to be effected.

The third determination is the primal Divine operation that first enters combat with what opposes, subduing the earliest universal resistance that rose in active falsity.

The fourth determination is the Divine loved for pure illumination, the honored delight of heavenly wisdom by which goods become radiant and truths lovable.

The fifth determination is the Divine formative intelligence that builds new states for restoration: it establishes a renewed heavenly order for the reception of good and truth, and at the same time fixes restraint and confinement for the opposing will and its derivative persuasions.

The sixth determination is living Divine power that draws the initiating good up out of immersion in falsity and evil, and then sets the lower degrees into order so that what is Divine is separated from what is defiled, and hostile forces are held fast and prevented from breaking out.

The seventh determination is the mediating Divine agency that governs the intermediate region between higher and lower states, disposing all deliberations so that influx is adapted to recipients.

The eighth determination is Divine truth made manifest in splendor for liberation, actively loosing what is bound in human interiors and restoring souls to freedom of reception.

The ninth determination is the universal heavenly understanding into which all genuine communities of worship and doctrine are gathered as into one mind, and to which returns every vitality that has been purified from mixed states.

These are the nine determinations of honor established in the outer spiritual expanse for the enduring heavenly principles in the kingdom of Divine glory, in an unending state.

In contrast, another nine determinations are appointed within the intermediate realm where mixture and conflict occur.

In the orderly alternations of enlightenment, three determinations are fixed: the mediating agency that adapts, the universal vivifying power that inspires and unites, and the rescuing living power that arranges and restrains.

In the alternations of obscurity, three determinations are fixed: the manifest liberating truth, the initiating good that first engaged the opposite, and the pure receptive principle kept undefiled for new reception. Thus governance remains established in both brightness and shade.

A further governing determination is fixed in the highest completed degree of the formed order, upon which is present the supreme sovereignty of Divine glory ruling the whole complex in ultimates.

Another governing determination is fixed in the common intermediate region that joins inner and outer states, upon which stands the discriminating Divine truth that judges every person; before it three final outcomes are made distinct: one that ends in spiritual death, one that opens into spiritual life, and one that remains in divided mixture.

These are the great governing determinations established within the intermediate world under the heavenly realm, acknowledged in their order; yet at this point the presentation breaks and cannot be fully carried further in its present damaged form.

paragraph_translations.translation: A complete complement of governing determinations is fixed by appointment in an ordered arrangement of degrees. Though a portion of them is set in the outer spiritual expanse where general states are held, their authority still extends through every condition where devastation and disorder prevail.
paragraph_translations.notes: The phrase about being appointed in fixed places translates as determinations fixed in ordered degrees; “worlds of the damage” is taken as states of devastation/disorder.

paragraph_translations.translation: The first and highest governing determination is the inmost Divine itself in sovereign truth and good: self-subsistent, unconditioned, and distinct from all derivative things, standing above every other determination as the measure of their subordination.
paragraph_translations.notes: The piled titles function as one idea of supreme Divine sovereignty in truth/good.

paragraph_translations.translation: The second governing determination is glorified Divine wisdom, from which proceeds the whole ordered outflow of spiritual forces that reaches down into the lowest region where renewal must be worked.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Origin of all emanations that have come to this world” is rendered as wisdom’s proceeding influx to the lowest restorative level.

paragraph_translations.translation: The third governing determination is the primal Divine operation that first confronts what opposes, bringing down the earliest universal resistance that arose from active falsity.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Humiliated the entire first enmity” is taken as subduing the first universal opposition.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fourth governing determination is the Divine loved for pure illumination, the honored delight within the heavenly expanse by which truths are made lovable and goods are made bright.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Beloved of the Lights” is treated as Divine illumination as an object of love.

paragraph_translations.translation: The fifth governing determination is Divine formative intelligence constructing new states for restoration: it establishes a renewed heavenly order for the reception of good and truth, and simultaneously fixes restraint and confinement upon the opposing will and all persuasions that proceed from it.
paragraph_translations.notes: “New aeon” becomes renewed spiritual state/order; “binding and prison” becomes restraint and fixed limitation.

paragraph_translations.translation: The sixth governing determination is living Divine power that draws the initiating good up out of immersion in falsity and evil, and then sets the lower degrees into order so that what is Divine is cleansed from what is defiled and hostile forces are held in bonds.
paragraph_translations.notes: The rescue and the ordering are treated as one continuous operation; “cleansing of the light” becomes separation of Divine from defiled.

paragraph_translations.translation: The seventh governing determination is the mediating Divine agency ruling the intermediate region, disposing every deliberation and counsel so that influx may be adapted to those who receive it.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Master of all advices” is taken as governance of deliberations/adaptation.

paragraph_translations.translation: The eighth governing determination is Divine truth made manifest in splendor for liberation, the active deliverer and restorer that looses what is bound in human interiors and leads souls back into freedom of reception.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Releaser and redeemer” is rendered as liberation/restoration of reception.

paragraph_translations.translation: The ninth governing determination is the universal heavenly understanding into which all genuine communities of worship and doctrine are gathered as into one mind, and to which returns every vitality purified from mixed and contaminated states.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Churches” is translated as genuine communities of worship/doctrine; “life” as vitality.

paragraph_translations.translation: These nine governing determinations are established as honors in the outer spiritual expanse for the enduring heavenly principles, in the kingdom of Divine glory, in an unending state.
paragraph_translations.notes: The closing liturgical formula is rendered as perpetuity/unending state.

paragraph_translations.translation: In contrast, there is also a corresponding complement of governing determinations appointed within the intermediate realm where mixture and conflict occur.
paragraph_translations.notes: “World of the zone” is treated as an intermediate realm of mixture.

paragraph_translations.translation: Within the orderly alternations of enlightenment, three governing determinations are fixed: the mediating agency that adapts, the universal vivifying power that inspires and unites, and the rescuing living power that arranges and restrains.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Ship of the day” is taken as a state/phase of enlightenment; the titles are translated by function.

paragraph_translations.translation: Within the alternations of obscurity, three governing determinations are fixed: the manifest liberating truth, the initiating good that first engaged the opposite, and the pure receptive principle preserved undefiled for new reception. Thus governance is held established through both brightness and shade.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Ship of the night” is taken as a state/phase of obscurity; “Virgin of Light” is rendered as pure receptivity kept undefiled.

paragraph_translations.translation: A further governing determination is fixed in the highest completed degree of the formed order, and upon it is present the supreme sovereignty of Divine glory ruling the whole complex in ultimates.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Seventh firmament” is taken as the highest completed degree within the formed (natural-spiritual) order.

paragraph_translations.translation: Another governing determination is fixed in the common intermediate region that joins inner and outer states, and upon it stands the discriminating Divine truth that judges every person. Before it three final outcomes are made distinct: one that ends in spiritual death, one that opens into spiritual life, and one that remains in divided mixture.
paragraph_translations.notes: “Atmosphere” is treated as a common intermediate region; “three paths” are taken as final outcomes.

paragraph_translations.translation: These are the great governing determinations established within the intermediate world under the heavenly realm, acknowledged in their order; yet at this point the presentation breaks, and the remaining statement cannot be carried through coherently from the damaged form that survives.
paragraph_translations.notes: Source explicitly breaks; the concluding clause about honoring in order is kept, but the remainder is irrecoverable.

spiritual_reading.overall_coherence: Coherent as a structured listing of governing degrees: first nine in a higher/outer expanse, then a second nine in an intermediate realm with alternating states, culminating in judgment and an explicit textual break. The voice is consistent until the final damaged ending, where continuity fails because the source itself is broken.

findings.diagnosis: A continuous administrative catalogue of thrones/jurisdictions in the ‘outer aeons.’ This is not a functional (correspondential) teaching but a ranked inventory of exalted offices. The spiritual reading does not really ‘stumble’ here; it successfully paraphrases governance as ‘determinations,’ which fits the voice, but that is already a sign the substrate (functional correspondences) is not what we are reading.
findings.evidence: Text is pure appointment + titulary: “Eighteen great thrones… are appointed… established in eighteen places… nine… in the outer aeons” (¶1). Then a numbered list: “The first throne is… the second throne is… the third throne…” (¶2-10), ending with a doxological closure “for ever and ever, amen” (¶11). The spiritual reading itself frames everything as “governing determinations… fixed… appointed… authority” and treats titles as governance; it does not derive meaning from what things *do* (function) but from what/who they *are* in rank—matching administrative voice.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶1-11 as an administrative throne-catalogue (ranked titulary list of outer-aeon thrones) rather than correspondential substrate.

findings.diagnosis: Seam/bridge that shifts from the first administrative block (outer aeons) to a second administrative block (zone/world). This is a normal structural hinge, not an insertion by itself.
findings.evidence: “In contrast, these are the other nine thrones that are appointed in this world of the zone.” The spiritual reading marks it as “SHIFTS,” but does not report any narrative strain; it functions as a clean divider.

findings.diagnosis: Second administrative catalogue: thrones distributed by cosmic ‘stations’ (day ship/night ship/firmament/atmosphere) with office-holders assigned. The spiritual reading again does not stumble; it allegorizes (‘alternations of enlightenment/obscurity’), but the underlying text remains jurisdictional placement, not functional correspondence. No localized insertion is required: the whole block is homogeneous in voice.
findings.evidence: Placement language dominates: “Three thrones in the ship of the day…” (¶13); “another three in the ship… of the night” (¶14); “the seventh throne… in the seventh firmament” (¶15); “the eighth throne… in the atmosphere” (¶16). Titles are administrators seated on thrones (“sits upon it”). Even the ‘three paths’ are framed as courtroom administration: “The Judge of truth… judges all mankind. Three paths shall be distinguished before him…” (¶16). The spiritual reading’s ability to translate ships/firmament/atmosphere as ‘states’ is an interpretive overlay, not something demanded by the text’s function-based logic.
findings.scope: Annotate ¶13-16 as administrative cosmography (thrones assigned to stations: day-ship/night-ship/firmament/atmosphere) rather than correspondential teaching.

findings.diagnosis: Genuine textual damage at the conclusion (explicit break). The spiritual reading stumbles only because the manuscript breaks, not because of a detectable insertion or voice clash.
findings.evidence: Text: “and the [remainder of the discourse is broken]” (¶18). The reading likewise: “presentation breaks… cannot be fully carried further… damaged form.” Removing anything does not restore coherence; the source is physically incomplete.

textual_criticism.summary: 4 findings: (1) ¶1-11 is a coherent administrative throne-inventory (annotate); (2) ¶12 is a clean hinge (no action); (3) ¶13-16 is a coherent administrative cosmographic distribution (annotate); (4) ¶18 is genuine manuscript damage (no action). No specific ‘insertion into a functional narrative’ is evidenced because the chapter is administratively voiced throughout, with the only real disruption caused by physical breakage at the end.

harmonized_paragraphs.text: Eighteen [great thrones for all the fathers] exist and are appointed, which are established in eighteen places! While there are nine among them [appointed in] the outer aeons, they exist [i]n all the worlds of the damage.

The first throne is the throne of the Father, the God of [trut]h, the King of the aeons of greatness, the one who exists; who is established [in the aeon of the Father] he alone, in his own essen[c]e, [existing alone] apart. This is the first throne [of the Father] the one that surpasses all the thrones.
⟨p.82⟩ The second throne is that of the [gl]orious Mother of Life. She is the origin of all the emanations that have come to this world.
The third throne is constructed for the father, the First Man. He is the one who humiliated the entire first enmity, which existed in the worlds of darkness.
The fourth throne is that of the Beloved of the Lights, the great honoured Beloved of the aeons of greatness.

The fifth throne is that of the glorious Great Builder; the great architect who built the new aeon for a newness, for [a new aeon] for [the] fathers of light; also for a place of binding and a prison for the enemy and his powers.

[The sixth thro]n[n] is that of the Living Spirit, the [glorious] mighty one, he who bore up the First Man out from the [land of darkness]; who also set in order and constructed the world [so that he might set in order and construct the worlds] both for a cleansing of the light, [and] for a binding [of the] powers of the enmity.
The seventh th[rone is] that of the Third Ambassador, the king of the zone, also the master of all advices.
The eighth throne is that of Jesus the Splendour, who [is] the releaser and redeemer [of] all souls.
The ninth throne is the throne of the great M[ind, he to whom] all the churches shall gather; and all the [life] that will be purified from the world returns to him.

These are the nine thrones of ho[no]u[r] appointed in the outer aeo[ns], <which are established> for the fathers of the glorious realm; [in the kingdom of the King of] Honour, for ever and ever, amen.
In contrast, these are the other nine thrones that are appointed in this world of the zone.
Three thrones in the ship of [the d]ay: one is that of the Ambassador, the second i[s that of] the Great Spirit, the third is that of the Living Spirit.

⟨p.83⟩ Once again, there are another three in the ship that [belongs to the night]: the first is the throne of Jesus the Splendour, [the second is that of] the First Man, the third is tha[t of the Virgin of] Light. These six thrones are established in the two ships.
Also, the seventh throne is established in the seventh firmament. The great King of Honour sits upon it.

The eighth throne is established in the atmosphere. The Judge of truth sits upon it, he who judges all mankind. Three paths shall be distinguished before him: one to death, one to life, on[e] to the mingling.

Th[ese] are the [nin]e great [th]ro[nes of honour] that are established in this world of [the zone] of the glorious realm, the one that the [king of honour and his powers] honour them [in their order] and the [remainder of the discourse is broken].

changes_summary: No changes made. Findings 1 and 3 recommend annotation only (¶1–11; ¶13–16), not excision. Findings 2 and 4 recommend none (¶12; ¶18), so the text remains unchanged.
